summary: Shelf is a self-hosted asset tracking system designed to help teams catalogue and monitor equipment across multiple locations. It functions as a centralised asset database and includes built-in tools for generating QR codes to label physical items. The platform is free to use with unlimited asset capacity under an open-source licence.
goodFor: Teams managing physical inventory or equipment pools who want an internal directory without per-user SaaS subscription costs.
watchOut: Because asset tracking depends heavily on reliable physical tagging and consistent user scanning habits, adoption friction within your team is a primary risk.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination and ensure you configure persistent storage for your database and uploaded files.
